newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SmithKline to make vaccines in China-report.
newsitem.headline: SmithKline to make vaccines in China-report.

text.p: SmithKline Beecham Biologicals, a Belgian unit of British drugs group SmithKline Beecham Plc, has received clearance from China's authorities to begin selling and making its vaccines at its SmithKline Biologicals Shanghai Ltd joint venture, Belga news agency reported on Wednesday.

The joint venture, which was set up in 1995, will initially only sell the company's Havrix Hepatitis A vaccine but will manufacture it and other vaccines locally from 1998, once a plant in Shanghai's Zhangjiang High Tech Park is finished.
"The initial investment approved by the Chinese authorities is around $30.4 million," Belga said, citing a SB statement.
SmithKline's local partners are China National Biological Products Corporation and the Shanghai Institute of Biological Products.
